"""Main finite sanitizer fixture for cap, query rejection and diagnostic scope lifecycle."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import traceback

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/diag-prefill-leaf-service-events-20261012')
T = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.tools/intel-llvm-v711/install')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('leaf_service_host_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
env = dict(PATH=str(T/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
           LD_LIBRARY_PATH=str(T/'lib'), STRATA_PREFILL_SERVICE_EVENTS='1')
source = B / 'prefill-leaf-service-host-fixture-v1.cpp'
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'main-prefill-leaf-service-host-fixture-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], gpu_executed=False,
             source=dict(path=str(source),sha256=m.sha(source)),
             header_sha256=m.sha(W/'include/strata/core/service_events.hpp'), environment=env,
             scope='Host-only diagnostic lifecycle under address/undefined sanitizers; no GPU or SYCL queue creation.')
    def save():
        (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
    owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save)
    r['commands']=owner.commands
    def run(label,args,wall):
        c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,out,wall=wall,cpu=wall*2,rss_cap=4<<30,
                           text_cap=16<<20,file_cap=16<<20,total_cap=32<<20)
        r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
        return so.read_text(),se.read_text()
    try:
        binary=out/'host-fixture'
        run('compile',[str(T/'bin/clang++'),'-fsycl','-std=c++20','-O1','-g','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                       '-Xarch_host','-fsanitize=address,undefined','-Xarch_host','-fno-omit-frame-pointer','-I'+str(W/'include'),
                       str(source),'-o',str(binary)],180)
        r['binary']=dict(path=str(binary),sha256=m.sha(binary),bytes=binary.stat().st_size)
        so,se=run('host-fixture',[str(binary)],60)
        assert so.strip()=='HOST_SERVICE_FIXTURE status=PASS overlap_refused=1 cap_submissions=200001 scopes=5 no_gpu_enqueue=1'
        assert not any(word in se for word in ['AddressSanitizer','runtime error:','LeakSanitizer'])
        rows=[dict(v.split('=',1) for v in line.split(': ',1)[1].split()) for line in se.splitlines()
              if line.startswith('strata prefill service events: ')]
        assert len(rows)==5 and [int(v['captured']) for v in rows]==[200000,1,1,0,0]
        assert [v['status'] for v in rows]==['incomplete']*4+['complete']
        assert rows[0]['overflow']=='1' and rows[0]['checked_boundary']=='0' and rows[0]['query_errors']=='0'
        assert rows[1]['query_errors']=='1' and rows[1]['checked_boundary']=='1'
        assert rows[2]['bookkeeping_failed']=='1' and rows[2]['checked_boundary']=='0'
        assert rows[3]['checked_boundary']=='0' and rows[4]['checked_boundary']=='1'
        assert m.sha(source)==r['source']['sha256'] and m.sha(W/'include/strata/core/service_events.hpp')==r['header_sha256']
        r['summary_rows']=rows
        r['complete']=True
    except BaseException as error:
        r.update(error=repr(error),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc())
        r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'))
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ['passed','complete','error']}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
